title: Privacy Pass
subtitle: Token verifier for trusted issuers (Cloudflare, Apple, Fastly). Browsers holding a valid token silently bypass the challenge ladder for the configured trust duration.
notAttached.text: No protection module is wired — token verification is inactive.
register.title: Register issuer
register.desc: Provide a hex-encoded key_id (32 bytes = 64 hex chars) and public key (32 bytes for Ed25519). Use hmac_sha256 for local testing only — production deployments should use ed25519.
notes.production: Only <0>ed25519</0> tokens from public issuers (Cloudflare CAPTCHA bypass, Apple Private Relay, Fastly) are accepted in production.
notes.hmac: <0>hmac_sha256</0> is a shared-secret mode intended for local integration testing only.
notes.nonce: Nonce-cache size grows over the TTL window — replay attempts are silently dropped before signature verification.
